one.robotLine: Previewing ROBOT ONE's mechanisms (cascade, right toggle, left toggle, claw, flipper, ramp) on fakes built from their declarations' own numbers (an assumed time constant where a declaration states no kA), on the host test plant's STAND-IN drive — a 12 in tank on tracking wheels with made-up gains, not this robot's drive (its track width is not in the code yet) — with NO wall sensors: every wall reset is refused 'no sensor', as the robot's program does today. A step on a mechanism this robot does not have stops the route there, as it would on the robot.
